content: {"episode_id":"ep-05008","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"This appeal concerns the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, for diagnosis codes I34.0 and R00.2. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat, which are concerning for potential arrhythmias in the context of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency. Per that note, mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data during daily activities to correlate symptoms with any underlying cardiac conduction abnormalities."}
